mechanism: Naltrexone (opioid antagonist) may blunt the rewarding effects of methylphenidate and increase abuse liability through compensatory dosing; both drugs affect CNS stimulation with potential additive effects on heart rate and blood pressure.
action: Monitor cardiovascular parameters and for signs of increased methylphenidate dosing; use caution in patients with cardiac disease; consider alternative ADHD agents if naltrexone continuation is essential.
